title: Promty — Pick up where you left off with AI
description: Promty keeps project decisions, open questions, and next steps ready so every teammate and AI session can continue without starting over.
heading: Pick up where you left off—without starting over.
summary: Return to a task with its current direction, important decisions, open questions, and next step already clear.
highlights: Resume with the current goal and next step already clear.
Keep decisions and trade-offs alongside the result.
Stay aligned across teammates, Codex, and Claude Code.

title: About Promty — Context belongs to the project
description: Promty exists because project context should outlive a chat, a tool, and a handoff.
heading: AI should move your project forward—not make you explain it again.
summary: A project should remember where it is, why it got there, and what should happen next.
highlights: Context outlives individual chats and tools.
Decisions keep their reasons instead of becoming another transcript.
People choose what carries forward.

title: Promty Product — One project memory for every AI session
description: See what happened, keep what mattered, and give the next teammate or AI session a clear place to begin.
heading: One project memory for every AI session.
summary: Promty keeps AI activity, project knowledge, decisions, questions, and next steps connected.
highlights: Follow interrupted and resumed work as one readable timeline.
Keep current direction, decisions, questions, and next steps together.
Give every new session the right starting point.

title: Connect Codex and Claude Code to Promty
description: Install the Promty Collector, connect an explicit repository, verify captured sessions, and make approved Project Memory available to future coding agents.
heading: Connect your AI coding tool.
summary: Follow the setup guide for Codex or Claude Code, authorize the Collector, test the connection, and review Project Memory before sharing it with another agent.
highlights: One repository-scoped installation command.
User-controlled browser authorization and revocable tokens.
Clear verification, privacy, and troubleshooting steps.

title: Privacy Notice · Promty
description: Learn what Promty collects, how Project Memory uses AI processing, how information is protected, and how to exercise privacy and deletion choices.
heading: Privacy Notice
summary: Promty explains what information is collected, how it is used, when external AI processing occurs, and the controls available to users.
highlights: Projects and prompt flows are private by default.
External AI generation requires a separate user choice.
Users can revoke tokens, delete projects, and delete their account.

title: Terms of Service · Promty
description: Read the terms that govern professional and business use of Promty, including accounts, user content, AI-generated material, and service responsibilities.
heading: Terms of Service
summary: These terms cover account responsibilities, submitted content, AI-generated material, acceptable use, third-party services, and service limitations.
highlights: You retain ownership of content you submit.
AI-generated material requires appropriate human review.
Account and Collector credentials must be kept secure.

title: Acceptable Use Policy · Promty
description: Review the safety, authorization, privacy, security, and content rules that apply when using Promty for AI-assisted software work.
heading: Acceptable Use Policy
summary: Promty supports legitimate software work and requires users to protect people, data, repositories, credentials, and connected systems.
highlights: Use only data, repositories, and systems you are authorized to access.
Do not upload secrets or confidential material without authorization.
Review generated output before using it where errors could cause harm.

title: Security and Vulnerability Reporting · Promty
description: Report a Promty security vulnerability privately and review the guidelines for safe, good-faith security research.
heading: Report a vulnerability
summary: Send security reports privately with clear reproduction steps and follow the safe-research guidelines when testing Promty.
highlights: Report vulnerabilities privately to security@promty.org.
Use only accounts and data you control.
Avoid destructive testing, disruption, and high-volume scanning.

heading: Let your AI connect Promty.
summary: This machine-oriented companion to the Collector guide provides a bounded setup contract for supported coding agents.
highlights: Use one explicit setup command.
Keep browser authorization under user control.
Verify successful activation before reporting completion.
